# Part 107 Quiz (part107quiz.com)

> Free practice questions for the FAA Part 107 remote pilot knowledge test
> (Unmanned Aircraft General - Small, "UAG"), with a written explanation and a
> regulation or handbook reference on every answer. 173 original multiple-choice
> questions across seven topics, all readable as plain HTML on the topic pages,
> a timed 60-question mock exam drawn at the FAA's current area weighting, and a
> free 50-question PDF. Independent and unofficial: not affiliated with or
> endorsed by the FAA or PSI.

## What is here that is worth citing

Every question is written by the site, not copied from the FAA's live test.
Each one tags the Remote Pilot ACS area it tests and ends with an explanation
of why the keyed answer is right and a reference (14 CFR section, AC 107-2A
paragraph, AIM paragraph, or FAA handbook section). The topic pages below
render the whole free bank for that topic as static HTML — question, options,
marked answer, explanation and reference — so it can be read and quoted
without running the quiz. The bank was re-audited against current rules on
2026-09-26; questions that failed (wrong key, two defensible answers, outdated
premise, ambiguous stem) were removed rather than patched.

## Part 107 knowledge test facts (checked 2026-09-26)

- Format: 60 scored multiple-choice questions plus 5 unscored validation
  questions, 120 minutes in total, at a PSI testing center. Pass mark 70% of
  the scored questions (42 of 60). Source: PSI "Unmanned Aircraft General -
  Small" Applicant Information Bulletin, effective September 29, 2025.
- Area weighting since September 29, 2025 (same bulletin): Regulations 48%,
  Airspace Classification and Operating Requirements 20%, Weather 5%, Loading
  and Performance 2%, Operations 25%. The FAA's August 2025 Airman Testing
  Community Advisory says this replaces the blueprint printed in the Remote
  Pilot ACS (FAA-S-ACS-10B) until the ACS is updated. Older study material
  that quotes ranges such as "Operations 35-45%" is out of date.
- From October 26, 2026 the FAA says the UAG test will also include
  image-based questions from current VFR charts that are not in the testing
  supplement (Airman Testing Community Advisory, September 2026 Special
  Edition). The supplement itself is FAA-CT-8080-2H.
- Pass rate for the initial test, from FAA airman knowledge test statistics:
  82.96% in 2025 and 84.20% in 2024, down from above 92% in 2017-2020.
- Retesting after a failure requires a 14-day wait (PSI bulletin).
- Staying current: to exercise the certificate you must have passed the
  initial test or completed the FAA's free online recurrent training within
  the previous 24 calendar months (14 CFR 107.65).
- Part 107 waiver applications now go through the FAA's Aviation Safety Hub;
  airspace authorizations still go through LAANC or FAA DroneZone.
- NOTAM stands for "Notice to Airmen" again since February 10, 2025.

## Practice pages (free, no account)

- [Full 60-question mock exam](https://part107quiz.com/mock-exam.html): 120-minute timer, drawn 29/12/3/1/15 by ACS area to match the current weighting, per-area score at the end.
- [Regulations](https://part107quiz.com/regulations.html) — 37 questions
- [Airspace and sectional charts](https://part107quiz.com/airspace.html) — 38 questions
- [Weather](https://part107quiz.com/weather.html) — 20 questions
- [Loading and performance](https://part107quiz.com/loading-performance.html) — 14 questions

## Paid option

An optional [Premium Pack](https://part107quiz.com/premium.html) (CA$29, PDF)
adds five non-repeating 60-question mock exams and a larger study bank. Every
practice test, explanation and study guide on the site stays free.
